title: Obsidian Pillars
description: A cluster of jet-black obsidian pillars juts from the cracked earth like the teeth of some buried leviathan. Their surfaces are razor-sharp and reflect the orange sky in dark, warped streaks. Between them, narrow gaps hold pockets of volcanic glass and wind-blown debris.

choices.label: Break off shards
choices.description: Carefully fracture pieces from the obsidian pillars.

choices.label: Harvest the glass deposits
choices.description: Collect the volcanic glass wedged between the pillars.

choices.label: Search between the pillars
choices.description: Rummage through the debris caught in the narrow gaps.
